basic.name: Penetrating Round
basic.description: Deal 205~~0.04~~ damage, knock back, and Slow enemies in a line by 20% for 2 seconds. Enemies close to Raynor are knocked back further.

basic.name: Inspire
basic.description:
Raynor and all nearby allied Minions and Mercenaries gain 30% Attack Speed and 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

Casting Inspire resets Raynor's Basic Attack cooldown.

basic.name: Adrenaline Rush
basic.description: Heal Raynor for 25% of his maximum Health over 1 second. Raynor's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 0.5 seconds, increased to 1 second against Heroes.

heroic.name: Hyperion
heroic.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66~~0.04~~ damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: Raynor's Raider
heroic.description:
Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84~~0.04~~ damage per second and regenerates 75~~0.04~~ Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee.

The Banshee respawns automatically after 45 seconds.

heroic.name: Command Raynor's Raider
heroic.description: Order the Banshee to attack an enemy.

trait.name: Give 'Em Some Pepper
trait.description: Every 4th Basic Attack splashes in a small area and deals 125% more damage to the main target.

trait.name: Give 'Em Some Pepper
trait.description: Every 4th Basic Attack splashes in a small area and deals 125% more damage to the main target.

level1.name: Exterminator
level1.description:
Basic Attacks deal 50% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. This is increased to 125% while Inspire is active. 

Passive: Inspire does not expire on friendly Minions and Mercenaries.

level1.name: Veteran Marksman
level1.description:
Quest: Every time the primary target of Give 'Em Some Pepper is a Hero, permanently increase its damage bonus by 0.75%.

Gambit: Gain 60% bonus Give 'Em Some Pepper damage. Every death reduces this bonus by 15%.

level1.name: Ace In The Hole
level1.description:
Deal 12% more damage to Stunned or Slowed Heroes.

Enemy Heroes hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper are Slowed by 10% for 2.5 seconds.

level4.name: Fight or Flight
level4.description: Reduce Adrenaline Rush's cooldown by 10 seconds. Casting Adrenaline Rush grants 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Sustaining Rounds
level4.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper heals Raynor for 3% of his maximum Health, increased to 6% if the primary target is a Hero.

level4.name: Behemoth Armor
level4.description:
Gain 200 bonus maximum Health. 

 Quest: Every time Give 'Em Some Pepper's primary target is a Hero, gain an additional 8 maximum Health.

level7.name: Heavy Slugs
level7.description: Increase Penetrating Round's Slow by 15% and its duration by 2 seconds.

level7.name: Fuel The Rush
level7.description:
While Inspire is active, Adrenaline Rush's cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks is increased to 2.25 seconds against non-Heroes, and to 4.5 seconds against Heroes.

Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Adrenaline Rush from 75 to 45.

level7.name: Unstable Compound
level7.description: Increase the radius of Give 'Em Some Pepper by 15%. Each enemy Hero hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper grants Raynor 10 Mana and reduces the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 1.5 seconds.

level10.name: Hyperion
level10.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66~~0.04~~ damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794~~0.04~~ damage.

level10.name: Raynor's Raider
level10.description:
Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84~~0.04~~ damage per second and regenerates 75~~0.04~~ Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee.

The Banshee respawns automatically after 45 seconds.

level13.name: Line 'Em Up
level13.description: Reduce the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 3 seconds. Penetrating Round hitting two or more enemy Heroes reduces its cooldown by an additional 3 seconds.

level13.name: Giddy-Up
level13.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed while mounted and unmounted. Inspire grants 10% more Movement Speed.

level13.name: Give Me More!
level13.description:
While Inspire is active, gain 1 Basic Attack range.

Passive: Increase Adrenaline Rush duration by 0.5 seconds, increasing the total amount healed by 12.5% of Raynor's maximum Health.

level16.name: Paint Them Red
level16.description: Increase the damage of Penetrating Round by 50% and heal for 90% of the damage Penetrating Round deals to Heroes.

level16.name: Rallying Cry
level16.description:
Increase the Attack Speed bonus of Inspire by 20%.

Passive: After every 12 Basic Attacks, cast Inspire for free.

level16.name: Bounty Hunter
level16.description:
If Give 'Em Some Pepper's target is a Hero, it deals an additional 3% of their maximum Health as damage and grants Raynor 10 Armor for 3 seconds. 

Activate Give 'Em Some Pepper to apply it to Raynor's next Basic Attack.

level20.name: Cavalry's Arrived
level20.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper lowers the cooldown of Hyperion by 5 seconds if the primary target is a Hero. These Heroes are targeted by the Hyperion for 100% increased damage for 6 seconds.

level20.name: Dusk Wing
level20.description: Increase the Health and leash range of Raynor's Raider by 100%. Its Basic Attack lowers enemy Hero Armor by 3 for 1 second, stacking up to 30.

level20.name: Raiders Roll
level20.description: Adrenaline Rush grants Unstoppable and continues healing for an additional 2 seconds. The additional duration ends upon reaching 70% Health.

level20.name: Sergeant Pepper
level20.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper now activates every 3 Basic Attacks.

level20.name: Execute Orders
level20.description:
When Raynor is killed, the Hyperion is cast towards the closest enemy Hero. It lasts 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemy Heroes of the lowest Health in the area for 66~~0.04~~ damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it will also fire its Yamato Cannon at the lowest Health enemy Hero, dealing 395~~0.04~~ damage.

Passive: Reduce Raynor's death timer by 35 seconds.
